order_title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 & Subsequent Amendments
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
enabling_act: Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 (Section 16 & Section 17)

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Prohibition regarding manufacture, storage, sale and distribution
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: No person shall manufacture or store for sale, import, sell or distribute goods specified in the Schedule which do not conform to the Indian Standard specified in column (3) of the said Schedule and do not bear the Standard Mark with the unique registration number allotted by the Bureau.

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Exemption for 100% Export and Prototype R&D
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: Nothing in this order shall apply to goods manufactured exclusively for export purpose or imported as prototypes for research and development up to 100 units per model with customs bonded undertaking.

Any person who contravenes the provisions of this Order shall be punishable under the provisions of Section 29 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 (Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine up to 5 Lakhs INR, or both).

covered_standards.product_description: Power Adapters for IT Equipment, Laptops, Mobile Phone Fast Chargers (HSN 8504.40)
Secondary Lithium-Ion Cells and Batteries for Portable Applications (HSN 8507.60)
Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements (Smart TVs, Set Top Boxes)
Mobile Phone Handsets - Indian Language Support (HSN 8517.12)
Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS / Inverters up to 2kVA) (HSN 8504.40)

order_title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020

key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: Every steel product specified in column (2) of the Schedule shall conform to the corresponding Indian Standard specified in column (3) and shall bear the Standard Mark under a licence from the Bureau of Indian Standards as per Scheme-I of Schedule-II.
Any steel product manufactured or imported in violation of this Order shall be liable for immediate confiscation at port customs or manufacturing warehouses by designated BIS Enforcement Officers.
No person shall manufacture, store for sale, sell or distribute Steel Bars and Wires unless they conform to IS 1786 and bear the Standard ISI Mark under a licence from the Bureau.

covered_standards.product_description: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars (TMT Rebars Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 600 - HSN 7214.20)
Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel Plates and Sections (HSN 7208.10)
Mild Steel for Metal Arc Welding Electrodes (HSN 7229.20)
Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings (HSN 7306.30)

issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Mandatory Conformity to Toy Safety Standards
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: Toys shall conform to the Primary Indian Standard IS 9873 (Part 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 9) and IS 15644 (for Electric Toys) and shall bear the Standard Mark under Scheme-I licence.

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Special Provisions for Artisans & Handcrafted Toys
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: Registered GI / Handloom artisans producing non-electric handcrafted wooden or clay toys may claim specific test exemptions under MSME Cluster initiatives.

covered_standards.product_description: Safety of Toys - Mechanical and Physical Properties (HSN 9503.00)
Safety of Toys - Flammability Requirements
Safety of Toys - Migration of Certain Toxic Chemical Elements (Heavy Metal Limits)
Safety of Electric Toys (HSN 9503.00)

order_title: Footwear made from Leather and other Materials (Quality Control) Order, 2023
issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: No footwear specified in the Table shall be manufactured, imported, distributed or sold without ISI Mark certification.
Micro and Small enterprises are given extended transitional compliance window up to 1st January 2024 with 80% testing fee subsidy.

order_title: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2017
issuing_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Mandatory Registration for Solar Modules & Inverters
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: All solar photovoltaic modules (Crystalline and Thin-Film) and grid-tied solar inverters deployed in government tenders or private rooftop installations must be registered under Scheme-II (CRS) with BIS.

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM)
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: Conformity to IS 14286 / IS 61730 is mandatory prerequisite for enlistment in MNRE ALMM List for government subsidized solar projects.

covered_standards.product_description: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules (HSN 8541.40.11)
Photovoltaic (PV) Module Safety Qualification - Construction
Photovoltaic (PV) Module Safety Qualification - Testing
Safety of Power Converters for use in Photovoltaic Power Systems (Solar Inverters) (HSN 8504.40)

order_title: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
enabling_act: Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 (Section 14 & Section 16)

key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: No jeweller shall sell gold jewellery or artefacts of 14k, 18k, 20k, 22k, 23k, or 24k purity unless laser-marked with BIS Logo, Purity Fineness mark, and unique 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmarking Unique ID (HUID) from an accredited AHC.

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Exemptions for Artisans and Small Turnover
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: Jewellers with annual turnover below 40 Lakhs INR and gold items under 2 grams are exempt from mandatory HUID registration.

covered_standards.product_description: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking (HSN 7113.19)
Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking (HSN 7113.11)

order_title: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Mandatory Licensure for Water
enabling_act: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 & BIS Act, 2016
statutory_scheme: Scheme-I (ISI Mark Mandatory for FSSAI License)

key_statutory_clauses.clause_heading: Mandatory BIS Certification for Packaged Water
key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: No person shall manufacture, sell or exhibit for sale packaged drinking water or mineral water except under the Bureau of Indian Standards Certification Mark (ISI Mark) and valid FSSAI central license.

order_title: Helmet for Riders of Two Wheeler Motor Vehicles (Quality Control) Order, 2020
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

key_statutory_clauses.clause_text: All protective helmets for two-wheeler riders must bear the Standard ISI Mark conforming to IS 4151. Sale of imported non-ISI helmets (including DOT/ECE non-BIS certified) is strictly prohibited on domestic roads.
